name: RNA backbone quantum chemical benchmark (46 dinucleotide families)
description: Benchmark dataset of quantum chemical reference calculations for 46 RNA backbone families using dinucleotide model units to assess methods for backbone conformations and energetics.
evaluation_method: MAE / RMSE (mean absolute error and root-mean-square error of predicted energies/geometries)
typical_sota_score: 0.2–2.0 kcal/mol (MAE, depending on method and level of theory)
reputation: Niche but valued within the computational chemistry / RNA modeling community as a reference set for validating methods for backbone conformations and energetics.
notes: Small, specialized non-LLM benchmark focused on quantum-chemical reference data; results depend strongly on chosen level of theory and conformational sampling; not a large-scale ML benchmark and not saturated.
